name: BK-5-MAPBT
summary: BK-5-MAPBT, also known as β-keto-5-MAPBT, is a possible entactogen of the benzothiophene and cathinone families. It is a potent monoamine releasing agent, including of serotonin and dopamine, and also acts as a potent serotonin 5-HT1B receptor agonist. Conversely, norepinephrine release was not reported.

pharmacology.text: It is a potent monoamine releasing agent, including of serotonin and dopamine, and also acts as a potent serotonin 5-HT1B receptor agonist. Unlike non-cathinone benzothiophenes like 5-MAPBT and 6-MAPBT, BK-5-MAPBT is very weak or inactive as a serotonin 5-HT2B receptor antagonist and monoamine oxidase A (MAO-A) inhibitor.
pharmacology.kind: Monoamine releasing agent; Serotonin 5-HT1B receptor agonist; Entactogen

uses.text: BK-5-MAPBT has been studied and patented by Matthew J. Baggott of Tactogen.
